description: Needs sign-in (connect this server with OAuth, or pass an API key as the Authorization: Bearer header). Upload a native build (Windows, macOS or Linux) of your desktop-app listing: mint this single-use, game-bound token (2 hours), then use upload-native.mjs with YOUGAME_NATIVE_TOKEN. With request, an owner or maintainer answers that crowd request as a test branch beside live: on owner-governed games the owner or an approver puts it in from Feedback; community games merge by vote. For ordinary uploads, make the build live afterwards with make_native_live (or the owner presses Make it live on Manage → Desktop builds). For Unreal, upload a Shipping build.

machine_label.description: A label you choose, such as Jam PC. Never a hostname or path.

note.description: What is different in this build, which players read as what changed: one line in plain words, then optionally a line "What to test:" and 2-3 steps, one per line. Letters, numbers, spaces, line breaks and , . ! ? : ; ' ( ) -, starting with a letter or number; words like token, secret, password or hostname are refused.

request.description: Answer one open crowd request with a test build. Only the game's owner or maintainers may do this.

name: native_upload_token
